title: iPermit Permit Explanation Record
description: Structured explanation emitted alongside each fired (or short-circuited) permit by the deterministic rules engine. See docs/specs/explainability.md (T00-05). Defers rule object field shapes to T00-01, ruleset versioning to T00-03, and engine implementation to T03-05.

schema_version.description: Version of this explanation record schema. Distinct from ruleset_version.

record_kind.description: fired = the rule triggered and a permit is in the matrix. not_fired = a negative explanation (T00-05 §5).

evaluation_date.description: Date the engine evaluated this project. Used by T00-03 to select effective ruleset.

content_hash.description: Hash of the effective ruleset snapshot used. Algorithm and snapshotting owned by T00-03.

commit_sha.description: Git commit SHA of the rules repository if the snapshot maps to one. Optional.

rule_refs.description: The rule(s) this record explains. Multiple entries only when a single permit output is the consensus of overlapping rules (e.g. county + state).

rule_status_at_evaluation.description: Status of the rule object at evaluation_date. archived is only valid for grandfathered replays (T00-03).

jurisdiction_chain.description: Ordered jurisdictions from Federal down to the most specific applicable jurisdiction, per AGENTS.md hierarchy. The rule's own jurisdiction MUST appear in this chain.

detection_source.description: How this jurisdiction entered the evaluation. See T05-04 / T06-02.

trigger_path.description: The conditions in the rule's triggers tree that were evaluated, with field paths, operators, and observed values. Required when record_kind = fired; for not_fired, this shows up to the failing leaf.

matched_summary.description: Plain-language collapsed restatement of which branches matched. Derived; included for human review.

applicable_thresholds.description: Numeric thresholds that governed the decision, lifted from matching leaves of trigger_path. Empty array when the rule's triggers contained no numeric comparisons.

threshold_value.description: Threshold from the rule. Number or ISO date string.

actual_value.description: Observed value from project inputs at evaluation time.

units.description: Units string for human display (e.g. acres, days, count). Optional; the field registry (T02-02) owns canonical units.

citations.description: Copied verbatim from provenance.source_citations of every rule in rule_refs. Order preserved; duplicates collapsed by reference.

tier.description: Confidence tier copied from the rule. When multiple rules contribute, this is the LOWEST (most cautious) tier across rule_refs.

tier_rationale.description: Plain-language statement of why this tier applies. Combines AGENTS.md tier definitions with rule-specific context.

stale.description: True when days_since_verified exceeds the freshness threshold owned by T02-07. Surfaced independently of confidence per AGENTS.md Data Governance.

stale_reason.description: Required when stale = true. Human-readable reason (e.g. 'last verified 540 days ago; threshold is 365').

known_unknowns.description: Stated uncertainties. Union of the rule's known_unknowns and engine-detected uncertainties at evaluation time (e.g. partial GIS overlap, intake field missing).

origin.description: rule = copied from rule.known_unknowns. engine = detected at evaluation time.

engine_signal.description: Required when origin = engine. Identifier of the engine signal (e.g. partial_gis_overlap, missing_intake_field, citation_url_unreachable).

advisories.description: At least one advisory MUST be present per AGENTS.md Liability Strategy. Union of rule.advisories and any engine-injected disclaimers (e.g. stale freshness, low confidence).

origin.description: platform = the standing advisory required for every permit record (e.g. 'Advisory only; not a legal determination').

evaluation_trace.description: Exactly six entries, one per AGENTS.md evaluation step (T00-01 §8). Order is fixed: jurisdiction, temporal_validity, project_type, trigger_conditions, spatial_overlays, dependencies.

outcome.description: skipped = an earlier step short-circuited, so this step was not evaluated.

detail.description: One-line explanation of the outcome (e.g. 'rule jurisdiction us-federal in chain', 'project_type substation not in applicable_project_types').

negative_explanation.description: Required when record_kind = not_fired. The step that short-circuited and a human-readable reason.

inputs_hash.description: Hash of the canonical project inputs (intake + confirmed GIS) used. Combined with ruleset_version.content_hash and evaluation_date, this triplet keys the reproducibility contract (§6).

deterministic.description: Asserts the record was produced by the deterministic engine path; no AI-derived fields are present in this record.

regeneration_note.description: Optional note from the engine about reproducibility caveats (e.g. 'GIS dataset version 2026.04 must be available for replay').

allOf.description: trigger_path is required when record_kind = fired
negative_explanation is required when record_kind = not_fired

expected_value.description: Threshold from the rule. Omitted for operator = exists.

actual_value.description: Observed value at evaluation time. May be null when the field was absent from inputs.

evaluation_notes.description: Optional engine notes (e.g. 'value coerced from string to number', 'field absent; treated as null').
